Freestone family · Person

Thomas Freestone

1795–1858

Open in the family tree

Born
May 19, 1795 · Flixton, Suffolk, England
Died
July 1, 1858 · Utah (locality disputed)

Born May 19, 1795, in Flixton, Suffolk, England, to George Freestone and Ann Youngman. Married Ann Fall on August 1, 1837, in Crapaud, Prince Edward Island. Their family included eight children. Thomas and Ann traveled to Utah in the 1853 Miller and Cooley company. FamilySearch records his death on July 1, 1858; the precise locality and circumstances remain disputed.
